fusions.name: Leaf Flight
fusions.desc: Flicks a bolt at the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage. Its damage rises 4% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 20%).

fusions.name: Hard Crease
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 12 damage and stuns the target for 1 second, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Fine Print
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 20% for 20 seconds.

fusions.name: Quick Draft
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner.
